2. White has no adequate defense—any defensive try like Rb1 fails to Rxb1
3. The threat is unstoppable: either Rh1 leads to mate/overwhelming advantage, or Black dominates with both rooks on the 1st and 2nd ranks

**Coaching note:** When you have two rooks on an open file near the enemy king, look for ways to penetrate the back rank. The back rank is where checkmate lives. Coordinate your rooks to create unstoppable mating threats—even if mate isn't immediate, the king will be forced into a losing position.
